chunks: Discord may arise from both the woman and the man together, and this is among what Allah, Mighty and Majestic, has said.
And if you fear discord between them, then appoint an arbitrator from his family and an arbitrator from her family.

So the man chooses a man, and the woman chooses a man; then the two meet upon separation or upon reconciliation. If they intend reconciliation, they reconcile without seeking permission; but if they intend to separate, then they have no right to separate except after seeking the permission of the husband and the wife.

key_terms.الشِّقَاقُ: serious marital discord and split between spouses
key_terms.الْإِصْلَاحَ: restoring harmony and mending the relationship
key_terms.حَكَمًا: an arbitrator appointed to help judge and resolve the dispute

ai.seo_question: What should be done in Islam when serious discord arises between husband and wife?
ai.summary: This passage addresses marital discord and explains the procedure of appointing arbiters from both sides of the family. It clarifies that the arbiters may enact reconciliation directly, but they cannot impose separation without the consent of both spouses.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Disputes (shiqaq) can arise from both the husband and the wife. This is related to what Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic, has said:
"And if you fear discord between them, appoint an arbitrator from his family and an arbitrator from her family." (Surah An-Nisa 4:35)

The husband should choose a representative from his family, and the wife should choose a representative from hers. These two arbitrators will then meet to decide either on separation or reconciliation.
If they intend reconciliation, they may proceed with it without seeking further permission. However, if they wish to separate the couple, they are not allowed to do so unless they seek the consent of both the husband and the wife.
